description:
Establish population-count and fused-reduction baselines. Establish reproducible operation-equivalent external baselines without changing production kernels.

## Background

Scalar POPCNT, existing AVX2 lookup kernels and carry-save algorithms have different crossover behavior. Published results from other processors are hypotheses, not measurements for the 5900X.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Satisfy the [Zen 3 measurement contract](dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/measurement-contract.md) for correctness, reproducible release benchmarks, comparison validity and adoption; receipts pin its committed version, the frozen protocol and the cell addendum. Include mandatory before/after evidence for production changes and preserve negative outcomes.

- [hard] REQ-02: Pin libpopcnt and the Mula reference implementation revisions and selected backends. Include the existing nibble lookup, scalar POPCNT and compiler-optimized count_ones loop as labeled internal controls.

- [hard] REQ-03: Validate identical buffers, bit lengths, tail semantics and returned counts, including fused AND/XOR reductions only where the external operation matches. Include any temporary buffers and extra passes in consumer-equivalent timings.

- [hard] REQ-04: Commit frozen family addenda and baseline receipts covering small inputs, vector/CSA boundaries, alignment, bit patterns, cache-resident and streaming data. Observe the emitted instructions instead of importing another processor's dispatch thresholds.

## Notes

Pin exact source and build identities in the family addendum. Preserve unavailable, incompatible and losing arms rather than substituting a different operation.
title: Establish population-count and fused-reduction baselines
